```sql
WITH sep_spend AS (
    SELECT 
        m.marketing_channel,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN s.currency = 'AUD' THEN s.spend_local * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE s.spend_local
            END
        ) AS ad_spend
    FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend s
    JOIN reference.marketing_channels m ON s.marketing_channel = m.marketing_channel
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON s.spend_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE s.spend_date >= '2025-09-01' AND s.spend_date <= '2025-09-30'
      AND m.is_paid = TRUE
    GROUP BY m.marketing_channel
),
sep_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.marketing_channel,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.line_total
            END
        ) AS attributed_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-09-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30'
      AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
      AND o.marketing_channel IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.marketing_channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(r.marketing_channel, s.marketing_channel) AS answer
FROM sep_spend s
FULL OUTER JOIN sep_revenue r ON s.marketing_channel = r.marketing_channel
WHERE COALESCE(s.ad_spend, 0) > 0
ORDER BY (COALESCE(r.attributed_revenue, 0) / s.ad_spend) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
